comments.js-yaml: gray-matter@4.0.3 pins js-yaml ^3.13.1; we override it to 4.x to patch CVE-2026-53550 (GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68) and GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m, AND set a js-yaml 4.x front-matter engine in eleventy.config.js (gray-matter's default calls the removed safeLoad). Floor raised to 4.3.1 for GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj (quadratic CPU in !!omap resolution, affects 4.0.0-4.3.0); staying on 4.x rather than 5.x because the eleventy.config.js front-matter engine targets the 4.x API.
comments.@11ty/recursive-copy: eleventy 3.1.6 pins ^4.0.4, which depends on minimatch 3.x -> brace-expansion 1.x, still vulnerable to GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (fixed only in brace-expansion >=5.0.8). recursive-copy 5.0.2 uses minimatch ^10.2.4. Drop this override once eleventy ships a release depending on recursive-copy >=5.
comments.brace-expansion: eslint 10.x -> minimatch 10.x resolves brace-expansion 5.0.8, which bypasses the GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg mitigation (GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895, DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays). Fixed in 5.0.9.
